evaluate_progressive_tax_amount_and_subs.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    income = float(inputs["taxable_income"])
    actual_tax = 0.0
    actual_subsection = ""
    found = False
    for i in range(len(inputs["bracket_upper_bounds"])):
        if not found and income <= float(inputs["bracket_upper_bounds"][i]):
            actual_tax = float(inputs["bracket_base_amounts"][i]) + float(inputs["bracket_rates"][i]) * (income - float(inputs["bracket_thresholds"][i]))
            actual_subsection = str(inputs["bracket_labels"][i])
            found = True
    actual_tax = round(actual_tax, 2)
    amount_ok = abs(actual_tax - float(inputs["asserted_tax"])) <= 0.005
    subsection_ok = actual_subsection == str(inputs["asserted_subsection"])
    answer = "Contradiction"

    return {"answer": answer}
